proof_scope: Agentic-evals is the main Persona Dream pipeline gate. Cases execute run.sh/script entrypoints and read produced artifacts; pytest/unit-test commands are intentionally excluded.

claims.proves: Selected Persona Dream pipeline seams execute through real skill entrypoints: Pydantic step boundary triage, video_plan crew fail-closed gate, video_plan artifact production with crew bundle, provider packet dry-run routing, and pipeline-integrity audit surface with blocking finding readback.
claims.does_not_prove: Live paid provider generation, human perceptual quality, manual review of every script, or semantic dream quality.

capability_claims.description: Agentic-evals, not self-authored pytest suites, drives pipeline step readiness via runnable commands and artifact readbacks.

cases.name: pydantic-step-gate-triages-corrupt-input
command: T=$(mktemp -d); echo '{"not_schema":1}' > "$T/input.json"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/dag_step.py --node-id eval-gate --command noop --receipt "$T/receipt.json" --run-dir "$T" --consumes input.json --produces ''; ec=$?; cat "$T/receipt.json"; exit $((ec==1 ? 0 : 1))

cases.name: video-plan-blocks-without-crew-casting
command:
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-eval-nocrew.XXXXXX); set +e; bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D" --run-id eval-nocrew --no-write-memory >/dev/null; RC=$?; set -e; python3 - "$D" "$RC" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); rc=int(sys.argv[2])
assert rc == 3, rc
resp=json.loads((out/'response.json').read_text())
assert resp['status']=='blocked' and resp['reason']=='crew_casting_required', resp
assert not (out/'storyboard.json').exists()
print('VIDEO_PLAN_CREW_GATE_BLOCKED_OK')
PY

cases.name: video-plan-with-crew-produces-readback-artifacts
command:
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-eval-video-plan.XXXXXX); bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --crew-dir ../scripts/fixtures/crew --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D" --run-id eval-video-plan --no-write-memory >/dev/null; python3 - "$D" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
for name in ['storyboard.json','cinematography_coverage_receipt.json','timed_transcript.json','multimodal_prompts.json','voice_handoff_plan.json','manifest.json']:
    assert (out/name).is_file(), name
timed=json.loads((out/'timed_transcript.json').read_text())
voice=json.loads((out/'voice_handoff_plan.json').read_text())
coverage=json.loads((out/'cinematography_coverage_receipt.json').read_text())
prompts=json.loads((out/'multimodal_prompts.json').read_text())
assert timed['duration_seconds']==30 and len(timed['shots'])==4, timed
assert voice['owner']=='create-movie/audio-lane', voice
assert coverage['status']=='PASS_CINEMATOGRAPHY_COVERAGE', coverage
assert coverage['complies_with']=='best-practices-cinematography', coverage
assert '$watch --diarization pyannote --require-diarization' in coverage['watch_diarization_boundary'], coverage
assert 'diarization is deferred' in coverage['live_evidence_boundary'], coverage
assert [s['speaker'] for s in coverage['shot_plan'][:3]] == ['embry','horus','embry'], coverage
assert all(p.get('speaker') == t.get('speaker') and p.get('coverage') == t.get('coverage') for p,t in zip(prompts['prompts'], timed['shots'])), (prompts, timed)
print('VIDEO_PLAN_CREW_ARTIFACT_READBACK_OK')
PY

cases.name: spine-contract-requires-pydantic-triage-step-boundaries
command:
OUT=/tmp/persona-dream-pipeline-contract-agentic.json; bash ../run.sh check-pipeline-contract --receipt-out "$OUT" --json >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY2'
import json, yaml
from pathlib import Path
r=json.load(open('/tmp/persona-dream-pipeline-contract-agentic.json'))
assert r['status']=='PASS_PERSONA_DREAM_PIPELINE_CONTRACT', r
spine=yaml.safe_load(Path('../contracts/dream_spine.v1.yaml').read_text())
for step in spine['steps']:
    assert isinstance(step.get('consumes'), list), step
    assert step.get('validation') == {'input':'pydantic_first','output':'pydantic_first','failure':'triage-error'}, step
print('PYDANTIC_TRIAGE_STEP_BOUNDARIES_OK', len(spine['steps']))
PY2

cases.name: crying-routes-to-sfx-not-turbo-tag
command:
uv run --project .. python - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, '../scripts')
import chatterbox_utterances as u
assert '[crying]' not in u.EXTENDED_STYLE_TOKENS, 'crying tag must not be a Turbo inline token'
assert '[crying]' not in u.ALL_SUPPORTED_INLINE_TOKENS
grief = 'The grief of losing Kai came crying back; I sat with the ache.'
tags = u.choose_event_tags(grief, 'grief_safe')
assert '[crying]' not in tags, tags
text, used = u.inject_event_tags(grief, 'grief_safe')
assert '[crying]' not in text, text
chunks = u.compile_render_chunks(text, 'grief_safe')
assert chunks and all('[crying]' not in c['text'] for c in chunks), chunks
last = chunks[-1]
assert last.get('sfx_after', '').startswith('cry-'), last
lib = json.loads(pathlib.Path(last['sfx_after_library']).read_text())
assert last['sfx_after'] in {e['id'] for e in lib['entries']}, 'sfx asset must exist in chatterbox-speak library'
assert any(e['id'] == last['sfx_after'] and e.get('generated_by', {}).get('engine') == 'elevenlabs_v3' for e in lib['entries'])
t2, _ = u.inject_event_tags('[crying] I keep thinking about the devastating news.', 'grief_safe')
c2 = u.compile_render_chunks(t2, 'grief_safe')
assert all('[crying]' not in c['text'] for c in c2), c2
assert c2[-1].get('sfx_after'), 'model-emitted [crying] must route to sfx_after'
c3 = u.compile_render_chunks('The report finished on time. Two sections passed.', 'playful_light')
assert all('sfx_after' not in c for c in c3), c3
pg = u.prompt_guidance()
assert 'write [crying]' in pg and 'inert' in pg, 'guidance must forbid the inert tag'
print('CRYING_SFX_ROUTING_OK')
EOF

cases.name: canon-entity-gate-corrects-and-fail-closes
command:
D1=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-canon-e1.XXXXXX); bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --crew-dir ../scripts/fixtures/crew --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world with the Zeitch Eye and Tyranids in the background.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D1" --run-id canon-e1 --no-write-memory >/dev/null 2>&1; RC1=$?; D2=$(mktemp -d /tmp/persona-dream-canon-e2.XXXXXX); bash ../run.sh generate --mode video_plan --persona horus --secondary-persona embry --fixture ../scripts/fixtures/sample_residue.json --crew-dir ../scripts/fixtures/crew --about 'creating the SPARTA Explorer app' --scene 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a void world with the Tzenntch Eye watching.' --duration-seconds 30 --output-dir "$D2" --run-id canon-e2 --no-write-memory >/dev/null 2>&1; RC2=$?; python3 - "$D1" "$D2" "$RC1" "$RC2" <<'PY2'
import json, pathlib, sys
d1, d2, rc1, rc2 = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4])
assert rc1 == 0, rc1
corr = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d1) / 'canon_entity_corrections.json').read_text())
assert any(c['corrected'] == 'Eye of Tzeentch' and c['entity'] == 'Tzeentch' for c in corr['corrections']), corr
sb = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d1) / 'storyboard.json').read_text())
s = json.dumps(sb)
assert 'Eye of Tzeentch' in s and 'Zeitch' not in s, 'storyboard must carry corrected canon'
assert rc2 == 3, rc2
resp = json.loads((pathlib.Path(d2) / 'response.json').read_text())
assert resp['reason'] == 'canon_entity_ambiguous', resp
assert any('tzeentch' in a['candidates'] for a in resp['ambiguous_entities']), resp
assert not (pathlib.Path(d2) / 'storyboard.json').exists(), 'ambiguous canon must not compose a storyboard'
print('CANON_ENTITY_GATE_OK')
PY2

cases.name: conversation-renders-through-chatterbox-speak
command:
grep -q 'synthesize-batch' ../scripts/dynamic_conversation.py && { echo 'FAIL direct service call remains in dynamic_conversation.py'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'synthesize-batch' ../scripts/speak_reply.py && { echo 'FAIL direct service call remains in speak_reply.py'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'render_via_chatterbox_speak' ../scripts/dynamic_conversation.py && grep -q 'render_via_chatterbox_speak' ../scripts/speak_reply.py || { echo 'FAIL engine composition missing'; exit 1; }; D=$(mktemp -d); uv run --project .. python - "$D" <<'EOF'
import sys, json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '../scripts')
import dynamic_conversation as dc
out = dc.speak_horus(None, 'You said the Eye of Tzeentch watched. Was the calm real?', 'curious_searching', Path(sys.argv[1]), 'pd_horus_engine_test')
re_ = out['render_effects']
assert re_.get('render_path') == 'chatterbox-speak', re_
assert re_.get('render_temperature') == 0.85, re_
assert re_.get('pronunciation_normalized') is True, re_
assert out['audio_path'].stat().st_size > 10000, out
import speak_reply as srep
dest, resp = srep.speak('The grief sat quietly ... and the Eye of Tzeentch kept watching.', {'tone': 'grief_safe'}, Path(sys.argv[1]), 'pd_embry_engine_test')
assert resp.get('render_path') == 'chatterbox-speak', resp.get('render_path')
assert resp.get('render_temperature') == 0.85, resp.get('render_temperature')
assert dest.stat().st_size > 10000, dest
plan = json.loads((Path(sys.argv[1]) / 'pd_embry_engine_test.render_chunks.json').read_text())['render_chunks']
assert plan[-1].get('sfx_after', '').startswith('cry-'), 'crying SFX routing must compose through the engine'
print('CONVERSATION_ENGINE_COMPOSITION_OK')
EOF
